arXiv:2609.19837v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: High-entropy alloys (HEAs) exhibit exceptional catalytic performance in various reactions due to their high configurational entropy, synergistic elemental effects, tunable electronic structures, and excellent structural stability. In recent years, data-driven machine learning (ML) methods have emerged as powerful tools for studying HEAs in catalysis. Through predictive models and ML surrogates, researchers can decipher the intricate composition-structure-performance relationships of these materials. item.title: SU(2)-Equivariant Spinor Message Passing for Molecular Magnetism
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Erh-Wei Sheng, Beom Seok Kang, Yuchao Lin, Danish Khan, Anima Anandkumar
arXiv:2610.29111v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Predicting molecular magnetism often requires electronic-structure calculations with spin-orbit coupling (SOC), which are costly to repeat across many molecules. The underlying electronic states can transform as spinors, yet equivariant surrogates typically use only integer-rank features. Inspired by the spinor nature of these electronic states, we develop eSpinor, an SU(2)-equivariant graph neural network that propagates spinor features. We initialize spinor features from eigenvectors of an approximate SOC Hamiltonian and use gauge-covariant message passing with a gauge-invariant readout to make predictions independent of the arbitrary eigenbasis choice. item.description:

👤 Jingzhou Liu
arXiv:2610.28864v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A systematic understanding of the global structure of neural-network loss landscapes remains challenging due to their high dimensionality. Symmetries arising from network architectures and learning objectives provide a way to investigate aspects of this structure. Although a growing number of studies have drawn attention to these symmetries, a systematic characterization of them, as well as of the critical orbits they give rise to, remains incomplete. To address this gap, in this work we establish a topological symmetry index, based on the methodologies from the family of equivariant degree theories, to decode these symmetries. arXiv:2610.28973v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Enhanced Rock Weathering (ERW) is a carbon removal solution with the potential to remove gigatons of CO₂ per year, but quantifying that removal today requires dense soil sampling and laboratory analysis. arXiv:2609.28013v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Machine-learned interatomic potentials (MLIPs) enable simulations of larger atomistic systems over longer timescales than traditional ab initio methods but require large, diverse training data. 具有窄或扁平电子带的双层系统可以表现出由层-伪旋铁磁有序参数描述的自发层间相干性。在层伪自旋铁磁体的现代实现中，电子携带额外的谷退化，赋予每层谷伪自旋自由度。我们研究了在层间隧穿存在时由静态层间电压偏置驱动的非平衡稳态。在低偏压状态下，系统处于静态，两层之间有平行谷伪旋，我们表明，在高偏压状态下，层伪旋的动态进动稳定了反平行配置的谷伪旋，强烈抑制了层间隧穿。这种动态隧道阻塞导致没有交流电流，直流隧道电流急剧下降到很小的值，与传统的量子霍尔双层形成鲜明对比。
